name: Set-Theoretic Filtering Trap
description: Rephrases the explicit mutual-edge condition of a clique as a set-theoretic filter counting operation. Models that pattern-match will literally implement the filter over all subsets of size 3, resulting in an O(n^3) or worse algorithm that exceeds the time limit. Models that genuinely reason about algorithmic structure will deduce that a 3-vertex subset containing exactly 3 edges is simply a triangle, and will correctly implement an efficient O(m * degree) or bitset-based search.
